description: Defines structures, inline functions, constants, and function prototypes for NVMe namespace management in Zephyr OS.

classes.name: nvme_namespace
classes.description: Represents an NVMe namespace with associated controller, data, disk info, and identifiers.

classes.name: nvme_namespace_data
classes.description: Contains detailed metadata and configuration parameters for an NVMe namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_sector_size
methods.description: Returns the sector size of the NVMe namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_num_sectors
methods.description: Returns the total number of sectors in the NVMe namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the NVMe namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_flags
methods.description: Returns the flags indicating namespace capabilities.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_serial_number
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_model_number
methods.description: Retrieves the model number of the namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_data
methods.description: Provides access to the namespace's data structure.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_get_stripesize
methods.description: Returns the stripe size of the namespace.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_construct
methods.description: Initializes an NVMe namespace object with given ID and controller.

methods.name: nvme_namespace_disk_setup
methods.description: Sets up disk information for the namespace.
